verses.en: Hearken, O ye elders of my church, and give ear to my word, and learn of me what I will concerning you, and also concerning this land unto which I have sent you.
verses.sm: Faalogo mai ia, outou e toeaina o la’u ekalesia, ma uai mai o outou taliga i la’u upu, ma iloa mai ia te a’u mea ua Ou loto i ai e faatatau ia te outou, ma e faatatau foi i lenei laueleele lea ua Ou tuuina atu ia te outou.

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, blessed is he that keepeth my commandments, whether in life or in death; and he that is faithful in tribulation, the reward of the same is greater in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.sm: Aua e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, amuia lava o ia o lē e tausi i a’u poloaiga, pe i le olaga nei po o i le oti; ma o ia o lē e faamaoni i puapuaga, ua sili atu le tele o lona taui i le malo o le lagi.

verses.en: Ye cannot behold with your natural eyes, for the present time, the design of your God concerning those things which shall come hereafter, and the glory which shall follow after much tribulation.
verses.sm: E lē mafai ona outou vaaia i o outou mata faalenatura, i le taimi nei, le fuafuaga a lo outou Atua e faatatau i mea o le a oo mai pe a mavae le taimi nei, ma le mamalu e mulimuli mai pe a mavae puapuaga e tele.

verses.en: For after much tribulation come the blessings. Wherefore the day cometh that ye shall be crowned with much glory; the hour is not yet, but is nigh at hand.
verses.sm: Aua a mavae puapuaga e tele ona oo mai ai lea o faamanuiaga. O le mea lea, e oo mai le aso o le a faapaleina ai outou i le mamalu tele; e lei oo mai le itula, ae ua lata mai lava ona oo mai.

verses.en: Remember this, which I tell you before, that you may lay it to heart, and receive that which is to follow.
verses.sm: Ia manatua le mea lenei, lea ua ou muai ta’u atu, ina ia outou teuina i le loto, ma maua ai mea o le a mulimuli mai.

verses.en: Behold, verily I say unto you, for this cause I have sent you—that you might be obedient, and that your hearts might be prepared to bear testimony of the things which are to come;
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le pogai lenei na Ou auina atu ai outou— ina ia outou usiusitai, ma ina ia mafai ona saunia o o outou loto e molimau atu e uiga i mea o le a oo mai;

verses.en: And also that you might be honored in laying the foundation, and in bearing record of the land upon which the Zion of God shall stand;
verses.sm: Ma ina ia mafai foi ona faamamaluina outou i le faataatiaina o le faavae, ma i le molimau atu e uiga i le laueleele lea o le a faatuina ai i luga le Siona a le Atua;

verses.en: And also that a feast of fat things might be prepared for the poor; yea, a feast of fat things, of wine on the lees well refined, that the earth may know that the mouths of the prophets shall not fail;
verses.sm: Ma ina ia mafai foi ona saunia o se taumafataga o mea lololo mo e ua matitiva; ioe, o se taumafataga o mea lololo, o uaina ua i ai le ’alu ua faamamaina lelei, ina ia iloa e le lalolagi o le a lē iuvale lava fofoga o perofeta;

verses.en: Yea, a supper of the house of the Lord, well prepared, unto which all nations shall be invited.
verses.sm: Ioe, o se taumafataga o le maota o le Alii, ua saunia lelei, lea o le a valaaulia i ai atunuu uma.

verses.en: First, the rich and the learned, the wise and the noble;
verses.sm: Muamua, o e ua mauoa ma e ua aoaoina, o e atamamai ma e taualoa;

verses.en: And after that cometh the day of my power; then shall the poor, the lame, and the blind, and the deaf, come in unto the marriage of the Lamb, and partake of the supper of the Lord, prepared for the great day to come.
verses.sm: Ma a mavae lena ona oo mai lea o le aso o lo’u mana; ona o mai lea o e ua matitiva, o e ua pipili, ma e ua tauaso, ma e ua tutuli, i le tausamaaga a le Tamai Mamoe, ma taumamafa i le talisuaga afiafi a le Alii, ua saunia mo le aso tele o le a oo mai.

verses.en: Behold, I, the Lord, have spoken it.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou tautala atu ai.

verses.en: And that the testimony might go forth from Zion, yea, from the mouth of the city of the heritage of God—
verses.sm: Ma ina ia mafai ona oo atu le molimau mai Siona, ioe, mai le fofoga o le aai o le tofi o le Atua—

verses.en: Yea, for this cause I have sent you hither, and have selected my servant Edward Partridge, and have appointed unto him his mission in this land.
verses.sm: Ioe, o le pogai lenei na Ou auina mai ai outou iinei, ma Ou filifilia ai la’u auauna o Eteuati Paterika, ma Ou tofi atu ai ia te ia lana misiona i le laueleele lenei.

verses.en: But if he repent not of his sins, which are unbelief and blindness of heart, let him take heed lest he fall.
verses.sm: Ae afai e lē salamo o ia i ana agasala, o le lē talitonu lea ma le tauaso o le loto, ia faaeteete o ia ne’i pa’ū.

verses.en: Behold his mission is given unto him, and it shall not be given again.
verses.sm: Faauta ua tuu atu ia te ia lana misiona, ma e lē toe tuuina atu lava.

verses.en: And whoso standeth in this mission is appointed to be a judge in Israel, like as it was in ancient days, to divide the lands of the heritage of God unto his children;
verses.sm: Ma ai se e tulai mai i lenei misiona, ua tofia e avea ma faamasino i Isaraelu, e pei ona sa i ai i aso anamua, e vaevae laueleele o le tofi a le Atua i ana fanau;

verses.en: And to judge his people by the testimony of the just, and by the assistance of his counselors, according to the laws of the kingdom which are given by the prophets of God.
verses.sm: Ma e faamasino lona nuu i le molimau a e ua tonu, ma i le lagolago a ona fesoasoani, e tusa ma tulafono o le malo o le Atua e tuuina atu e perofeta a le Atua.

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, my law shall be kept on this land.
verses.sm: Aua e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tausia la’u tulafono i luga o lenei laueleele.

verses.en: Let no man think he is ruler; but let God rule him that judgeth, according to the counsel of his own will, or, in other words, him that counseleth or sitteth upon the judgment seat.
verses.sm: Ia lē tuu atu i se tagata ia manatu ua pule o ia; ae ia tuu atu i le Atua e pulea o ia o lē ua faamasino atu, e tusa ma le faamoemoe a lona lava loto, po o ua faapea, o ia lea o lē ua faufautua atu pe ua nofo i luga o le nofoa faamasino.

verses.en: Let no man break the laws of the land, for he that keepeth the laws of God hath no need to break the laws of the land.
verses.sm: Ia lē tuu atu i se tagata ia soli e ia le tulafono o le laueleele, ona o ia o lē e tausia tulafono a le Atua e le manaomia ona soli o tulafono o le laueleele.

verses.en: Wherefore, be subject to the powers that be, until he reigns whose right it is to reign, and subdues all enemies under his feet.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia outou tuu atu outou i lalo o pule ua i ai, seia nofotupu o ia o lē e ona le aiā e nofotupu ai, ma faatoilalo fili uma i lalo o ona vae.

verses.en: Behold, the laws which ye have received from my hand are the laws of the church, and in this light ye shall hold them forth. Behold, here is wisdom.
verses.sm: Faauta, o tulafono ua outou maua mai lo’u lima o tulafono ia o le ekalesia, ma o le malamalama lenei ia outou umia ai. Faauta, o le poto lea.

verses.en: And now, as I spake concerning my servant Edward Partridge, this land is the land of his residence, and those whom he has appointed for his counselors; and also the land of the residence of him whom I have appointed to keep my storehouse;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e pei ona Ou tautala atu e uiga i la’u auauna o Eteuati Paterika, o le laueleele lenei o le laueleele lea o lona alaalafaga, ma i latou o e ua ia tofia mo ona fesoasoani; ma o le laueleele foi lea o le alaalafaga o ia o lē ua Ou tofia e tausia lo’u faleteuoloa;

verses.en: Wherefore, let them bring their families to this land, as they shall counsel between themselves and me.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia tuu atu ia te i latou e aumai o latou aiga i le laueleele lenei, e pei ona latou fefautuaai ai i le va o i latou lava ma a’u.

verses.en: For behold, it is not meet that I should command in all things; for he that is compelled in all things, the same is a slothful and not a wise servant; wherefore he receiveth no reward.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, e lē tatau ona Ou poloai atu i mea uma; aua o ia o lē e tau faamalosia i mea uma, o ia lava lea o se auauna paie ma lē poto; o le mea lea e lē maua ai e ia se taui.

verses.en: Verily I say, men should be anxiously engaged in a good cause, and do many things of their own free will, and bring to pass much righteousness;
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu, e tatau i tagata ona auai ma le naunautai i se faamoemoega lelei, ma fai mea e tele i lo latou lava loto malie, ma aumai ai le amiotonu tele;

verses.en: For the power is in them, wherein they are agents unto themselves. And inasmuch as men do good they shall in nowise lose their reward.
verses.sm: Aua ua i totonu ia te i latou le mana, lea ua latou pule ai ia te i latou lava. Ma e tusa ai ma le faia e tagata o mea lelei, o le a leai lava se ala o le a aveesea ai lo latou taui.

verses.en: But he that doeth not anything until he is commanded, and receiveth a commandment with doubtful heart, and keepeth it with slothfulness, the same is damned.
verses.sm: Ae o ia o lē e lē faia e ia se mea seia poloaiina ai o ia, ma talia se poloaiga ma le loto masalosalo, ma ia tausia ma le paie, o ia lava lea e tausalaina.

verses.en: Who am I that made man, saith the Lord, that will hold him guiltless that obeys not my commandments?
verses.sm: O ai A’u o lē na faia le tagata, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, o le a ia lē tausalaina o ia o lē e lē usiusitai i a’u poloaiga?

verses.en: Who am I, saith the Lord, that have promised and have not fulfilled?
verses.sm: O ai A’u, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, ua Ou folafola atu ae ua lē faataunuuina?

verses.en: I command and men obey not; I revoke and they receive not the blessing.
verses.sm: Ou te poloai atu a ua lē usiusitai mai tagata; ou te aveesea ma latou te lē maua ai le faamanuiaga.

verses.en: Then they say in their hearts: This is not the work of the Lord, for his promises are not fulfilled. But wo unto such, for their reward lurketh beneath, and not from above.
verses.sm: Ona latou fai ifo lea i o latou loto: E lē o le galuega lenei a le Alii, ona ua lē taunuu ana folafolaga. Ae oi talofa i e faapea, ona o loo faatali mai lalō lo latou taui, ae ua lē mai i lugā.

verses.en: And now I give unto you further directions concerning this land.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu nei ia te outou ni isi faatonuga e faatatau i le laueleele lenei.

verses.en: It is wisdom in me that my servant Martin Harris should be an example unto the church, in laying his moneys before the bishop of the church.
verses.sm: O le poto ia te a’u, le tatau ona avea o la’u auauna o Matini Harisi ma faataitaiga i le ekalesia, i le tuuina atu o ana tupe i luma o le epikopo o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And also, this is a law unto every man that cometh unto this land to receive an inheritance; and he shall do with his moneys according as the law directs.
verses.sm: E le gata i lea, o se tulafono lenei i tagata uma o e e o mai i le laueleele lenei e maua ai se tofi; ma ia faia e ia i ana tupe e pei ona faatonuina e le tulafono.

verses.en: And it is wisdom also that there should be lands purchased in Independence, for the place of the storehouse, and also for the house of the printing.
verses.sm: Ma o le poto foi, le tatau ona faatau mai o ni laueleele i Initipene, mo le tulaga o le faleteuoloa, ma le fale lomitusi foi.

verses.en: And other directions concerning my servant Martin Harris shall be given him of the Spirit, that he may receive his inheritance as seemeth him good;
verses.sm: Ma o isi faatonuga e faatatau i la’u auauna o Matini Harisi o le a tuu atu ia te ia e le Agaga, ina ia mafai e ia ona maua lona tofi e pei ona lelei ia te ia;

verses.en: And let him repent of his sins, for he seeketh the praise of the world.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu ia te ia ia salamo i ana agasala, ona ua saili e ia le viiga a le lalolagi.

verses.en: And also let my servant William W. Phelps stand in the office to which I have appointed him, and receive his inheritance in the land;
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu foi i la’u auauna o Viliamu W. Phelps ia tulai i le tofi ua Ou tofia i ai o ia, ma talia lona tofi i le laueleele;

verses.en: And also he hath need to repent, for I, the Lord, am not well pleased with him, for he seeketh to excel, and he is not sufficiently meek before me.
verses.sm: Ma ua ia te ia foi se mea e tatau ona salamo ai, aua, o A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou lē fiafia tele ia te ia, ona ua saili o ia e fia sili, ma ua lē lava lona agamalu i o’u luma.

verses.en: Behold, he who has repented of his sins, the same is forgiven, and I, the Lord, remember them no more.
verses.sm: Faauta, o ia o lē ua salamo i ana agasala, o ia lava lea ua faamagaloina, ma o A’u, o le Alii, e lē toe manatuaina lava i latou.

verses.en: By this ye may know if a man repenteth of his sins—behold, he will confess them and forsake them.
verses.sm: O le mea lenei e mafai ai ona outou iloa pe afai ua salamo se tagata i ana agasala— faauta, o le a ia ta’uta’u atu ma lafoai i ai.

verses.en: And now, verily, I say concerning the residue of the elders of my church, the time has not yet come, for many years, for them to receive their inheritance in this land, except they desire it through the prayer of faith, only as it shall be appointed unto them of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni, Ou te fai atu e faatatau i le vaega o totoe o toeaina o la’u ekalesia, e lei oo mai le taimi, mo le tele o tausaga, mo i latou e maua ai lo latou tofi i le laueleele lenei, tau lava ona pei o le a tofia atu ai e le Alii ia te i latou, vagana ai ua latou mananao i ai e ala i le tatalo o le faatuatua.

verses.en: For, behold, they shall push the people together from the ends of the earth.
verses.sm: Aua, faauta, o le a latou tulei faatasi tagata mai tuluiga o le lalolagi.

verses.en: Wherefore, assemble yourselves together; and they who are not appointed to stay in this land, let them preach the gospel in the regions round about; and after that let them return to their homes.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia outou faapotopoto faatasi outou lava; ma o i latou o e e lei tofia e nonofo i le laueleele lenei, ia tuu atu ia te i latou e talai atu le talalelei i nofoaga o faataamilo ai; ma a mavae lena ia tuu atu ia te i latou e foi atu i o latou aiga.

verses.en: Let them preach by the way, and bear testimony of the truth in all places, and call upon the rich, the high and the low, and the poor to repent.
verses.sm: Tuu atu ia te i latou e talai atu i le ala, ma molimau atu e uiga i le upumoni i nofoaga uma, ma valaau atu i e ua mauoa, e ua maualuluga ma e ua maualalalo, ma e ua matitiva, ia salamo.

verses.en: And let them build up churches, inasmuch as the inhabitants of the earth will repent.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu ia te i latou e atia’e aulotu, e tusa ai ma le salamo o tagata o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And let there be an agent appointed by the voice of the church, unto the church in Ohio, to receive moneys to purchase lands in Zion.
verses.sm: Ma ia i ai se sui e tofia i le leo o le ekalesia, mo le aulotu i Ohaio, e talia tupe e faatau mai ai laueleele i Siona.

verses.en: And I give unto my servant Sidney Rigdon a commandment, that he shall write a description of the land of Zion, and a statement of the will of God, as it shall be made known by the Spirit unto him;
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu i la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone se poloaiga, ia tusi e ia se faamatalaga o le laueleele o Siona, ma se faamatalaga o le finagalo o le Atua, e pei ona o le a faailoa atu e le Agaga ia te ia;

verses.en: And an epistle and subscription, to be presented unto all the churches to obtain moneys, to be put into the hands of the bishop, of himself or the agent, as seemeth him good or as he shall direct, to purchase lands for an inheritance for the children of God.
verses.sm: Ma se tusi ma se pepa o le faasologa o igoa, e tuu atu i aulotu uma e maua ai tupe, e tuu atu i lima o le epikopo, o ia lava po o le sui, e pei ona lelei ia te ia, pe e pei ona ia faatonuina, e faatau mai ai laueleele mo se tofi mo le fanau a le Atua.

verses.en: For, behold, verily I say unto you, the Lord willeth that the disciples and the children of men should open their hearts, even to purchase this whole region of country, as soon as time will permit.
verses.sm: Aua, faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua finagalo le Alii ia tatala e soo ma le fanau a tagata o latou loto, e oo lava i le faatauina mai o le itulagi atoa lenei o le atunuu, i se taimi vave e mafai ai.

verses.en: Behold, here is wisdom. Let them do this lest they receive none inheritance, save it be by the shedding of blood.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le poto lenei. Ia tuu atu ia te i latou e fai lenei mea ne’i lē maua e i latou se tofi, vagana ai i le faamasaaina o le toto.

verses.en: And again, inasmuch as there is land obtained, let there be workmen sent forth of all kinds unto this land, to labor for the saints of God.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e tusa ai ma le mauaina o se fanua, ia auina atu tagata faigaluega ituaiga eseese uma i le fanua lenei, e galulue mo le au paia a le Atua.

verses.en: Let all these things be done in order; and let the privileges of the lands be made known from time to time, by the bishop or the agent of the church.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu nei mea uma ia faia i le faasologa tatau; ma ia tuu atu avanoa o le laueleele ia faailoa atu mai lea taimi i lea taimi, e le epikopo po o le sui o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And let the work of the gathering be not in haste, nor by flight; but let it be done as it shall be counseled by the elders of the church at the conferences, according to the knowledge which they receive from time to time.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu le galuega o le faapotopotoina ia lē faanatinatia, pe i se solaaga; ae ia tuu atu e faia e pei ona o le a soalaupuleina e toeaina o le ekalesia i konafesi, e tusa ma le malamalama latou te maua mai lea taimi i lea taimi.

verses.en: And let my servant Sidney Rigdon consecrate and dedicate this land, and the spot for the temple, unto the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone na te faapaia ma faamanuia lenei laueleele, ma le tulaga mo le malumalu, mo le Alii.

verses.en: And let a conference meeting be called; and after that let my servants Sidney Rigdon and Joseph Smith, Jun., return, and also Oliver Cowdery with them, to accomplish the residue of the work which I have appointed unto them in their own land, and the residue as shall be ruled by the conferences.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu ia taloina se fonotaga o le konafesi; ma a mavae lena ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Sini Rikitone ma Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, e foi atu, ma Oliva Kaotui foi faatasi ma i laua, e faauma le vaega o totoe o le galuega na Ou tofi atu ia te i latou i lo latou lava laueleele, ma le vaega o totoe e pei ona o le a faatonuina ai i konafesi.

verses.en: And let no man return from this land except he bear record by the way, of that which he knows and most assuredly believes.
verses.sm: Ma ia lē tuu atu i se tagata e foi mai lenei laueleele vagana ai ia molimau atu o ia i le ala, e uiga i mea ua ia iloa ma ua talitonu moni i ai.

verses.en: Let that which has been bestowed upon Ziba Peterson be taken from him; and let him stand as a member in the church, and labor with his own hands, with the brethren, until he is sufficiently chastened for all his sins; for he confesseth them not, and he thinketh to hide them.
verses.sm: Ia tuu mea na faaee atu i luga o Ziba Peterson ia aveesea mai ia te ia; ma ia tuu atu ia te ia e tulai o se tasi o le ekalesia, ma galue i ona lava lima, faatasi ma le au uso, seia lava ona aoaia o ia mo ana agasala uma; ona ua lē ta’uta’u mai e ia i latou, ma ua manatu o ia e nanā i latou.

verses.en: Let the residue of the elders of this church, who are coming to this land, some of whom are exceedingly blessed even above measure, also hold a conference upon this land.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i le vaega o totoe o toeaina o lenei ekalesia, o e o loo o mai i le laueleele lenei, o ni isi o i latou ua faamanuiaina tele i luga atu o le tulaga fuaina, ia latou faia foi se konafesi i luga o le laueleele lenei.

verses.en: And let my servant Edward Partridge direct the conference which shall be held by them.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Eteuati Paterika na te taitaia le konafesi o le a latou faia.

verses.en: And let them also return, preaching the gospel by the way, bearing record of the things which are revealed unto them.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu foi ia te i latou ia foi atu, ma talai atu le talalelei i le ala, ma molimau atu e uiga i mea ua faaali mai ia te i latou.

verses.en: For, verily, the sound must go forth from this place into all the world, and unto the uttermost parts of the earth—the gospel must be preached unto every creature, with signs following them that believe.
verses.sm: Aua, e moni, e ao ona alu atu le leo mai lenei nofoaga i le lalolagi atoa, ma i vaega aupito mamao o le lalolagi— e ao ina talai atu le talalelei i tagata uma lava, ma faailoga e mulimuli atu ia te i latou o e e talitonu.

verses.en: And behold the Son of Man cometh. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma faauta ua afio mai le Atalii o le Tagata. Amene.
